display.label: AWS Subnet
display.description: Provision Amazon VPC Subnets with IPv4/IPv6 CIDR blocks, availability zone placement, and public IP mapping

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique name and identifier for the subnet, applied as the 'Name' tag.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core subnet settings including name, parent VPC ID, primary IPv4 CIDR block, and availability zone.

fields.label: Subnet Name
fields.description: Unique name for the subnet, applied as the 'Name' tag and map key.

validation.pattern_error: Subnet name must only contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: VPC ID
fields.description: The ID of the VPC in which the subnet will be created.

fields.label: IPv4 CIDR Block
fields.description: The IPv4 network range for the subnet in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.1.0/24).

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g., 10.0.1.0/24).

fields.label: Availability Zone
fields.description: Availability zone for the subnet (e.g. us-east-1a).

sections.label: IP Addressing & Allocation
sections.description: Configure public IPv4 auto-assignment and IPv6 CIDR settings.

fields.label: Auto-assign Public IPv4
fields.description: Specify true to indicate that instances launched into the subnet should be assigned a public IP address.

fields.label: Assign IPv6 Address on Creation
fields.description: Specify true to indicate that network interfaces created in the subnet should be assigned an IPv6 address.

fields.label: IPv6 CIDR Block
fields.description: The IPv6 network range for the subnet in CIDR notation (/64 prefix length).

fields.label: IPv6-only Subnet
fields.description: Indicates whether to create an IPv6-only subnet.

sections.label: DNS & Hostname Settings
sections.description: Configure DNS queries, record generation, and hostname types for EC2 instances.

fields.label: Enable DNS64
fields.description: Indicates whether DNS queries to Amazon-provided DNS Resolver in this subnet return synthetic IPv6 addresses for IPv4 destinations.

fields.label: DNS A Record on Launch
fields.description: Indicates whether to respond to DNS queries for instance hostnames with DNS A records.

fields.label: DNS AAAA Record on Launch
fields.description: Indicates whether to respond to DNS queries for instance hostnames with DNS AAAA records.

fields.label: Private DNS Hostname Type
fields.description: The type of hostnames to assign to instances in the subnet at launch.

sections.label: Advanced Settings
sections.description: Availability zone identifier and local network interface indexing.

fields.label: Availability Zone ID
fields.description: AZ ID of the subnet (e.g., use1-az1).

fields.label: Local Network Interface Device Index
fields.description: Indicates the device position for local network interfaces in this subnet (e.g., 1 for eth1).

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organizational, tracking, and cost allocation purposes.

fields.label: Subnet Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the subnet.
